purpose: Repair the owner/reviewer readiness compatibility drift only after the existing password and a freshly verified authoritative TOTP have succeeded. This PR does not reset a password, replace or recover MFA, backfill production data, or authorize a release.
requiredInvariants: The authoritative MFA state remains auth.credential_states. The only compatibility write is public.users.mfaEnabled=true for the exact authenticated user.
The challenge compare-and-set is bound to the exact challenge, session and user IDs before a session can become active.
The compatibility finalizer accepts TOTP_ENROLL or TOTP_VERIFY only when the challenge and active session were both verified at transaction_timestamp() in the same transaction.
The session is unrevoked and unexpired, the challenge is unexpired, the verified method and MFA level are TOTP, and the session credential version equals the current credential version.

A successful TOTP may reconcile only redundant v1 key metadata whose ciphertext already has the valid v1 envelope. It never changes the ciphertext, enabled authority, backup hashes, password or throttle state.
BACKUP verification never calls the compatibility finalizer and can never approve an authenticator or key-metadata reconciliation.
The existing pc_auth_mfa_authority owner, column-bounded users ACL, runtime EXECUTE grants and PUBLIC revoke remain unchanged; no role or grant is added.
There is no one-time UPDATE or production backfill in the migration. Reconciliation occurs only inside a later ordinary authenticated TOTP transaction after an authorized release.
The isolated PostgreSQL DR restore proves the same function owner, ACL and fresh TOTP body after --no-owner --no-acl restore.
No password, TOTP value, setup key, backup code, ciphertext, cookie, token, email or other reviewer identifier is emitted by the patch or its evidence.
acceptance: Changed paths equal this eight-path allow-list and pass the source-controlled scope guard.
The forward-only migration changes only the existing finalizer body/owner/PUBLIC revoke and contains no broad auth-table write or data backfill.
Unit tests prove exact challenge/session/user CAS, TOTP invocation, backup-code exclusion and fail-closed rollback.
Throwaway PostgreSQL integration proves fresh TOTP_VERIFY false-to-true, idempotence, and rejection of backup, mismatched, expired, stale and credential-version-drift tuples.
DR rehearsal proves the restored fresh-TOTP finalizer boundary.
After a separately authorized exact-main release, one ordinary existing-password plus fresh-TOTP login is required before the read-only reviewer inspect may advance to 1/1.
